## Project Overview

**What it is:** A personal study plan generator for nursing exam prep. It reads a JSON file of missed questions (tagged by topic and nursing client needs), then generates a 7-day spaced-repetition study schedule with PN-scoped prompts (reinforce, monitor, report, follow care plan). Output can be human-readable text, JSON, or an editable journal file.

**Rules anyone must follow:**
- Standard library only, no network, no database—plain JSON files only
- **Critical:** Never enter actual or paraphrased questions from paid banks (UWorld, Archer, Kaplan)—topic tags and personal notes only
- All plan language must stay within PN scope of practice
- No gamification or streaks; keep 7 as the default day count; output format stays the same; don't change the journal
- For personal use only; don't package or publish
